svg.title: ECG: graph knowledge in the edge stream
svg.desc: The same graph access is followed from vertex eight and CSR position eighteen to a richer Full14 mask or a compact Scale6 token, normal property addressing, and a resident-line update. The property value is unchanged. A teaching cache contrasts recency with carried future reuse. Scale6 is the large-ID format, not the complete ECG design.
svg.text: ECG: graph knowledge in the edge stream
Reuse information travels with an ordinary-width edge record, then guides a cache decision.
one access; choose a format that fits
Small IDs leave more metadata space: Full14 uses 14 bits; Twitter's 26-bit IDs leave 6 for Scale6.
the graph and property values do not change
resident metadata, not a property-value rewrite
A was used at 18; B at 19.
The cache comparison is a worked two-way example, not a benchmark result. Data bytes stay unchanged.
cache_sim implements both formats; the native RISC-V record/property pair currently uses Scale6.
Prefetch is a separate path. Its native implementation and full timing/area qualification remain open.
